engine_protection_fault_log_entry_t: one entry of an engine protection fault log (8 bytes; the same name and field names as CM848's type). Each log is 5 entries (40 bytes) in e2m block 10DA; the index (history +0x18 / +0x1c) wraps modulo 5 (divsl #5 at 0x19520). CM550 keeps the extreme unsigned (start 0 or 0xffff, unsigned compares in cm550_isEngineProtectionInputMoreExtreme) where CM848 keeps it signed (0x8000 / 0x7fff)
engine_protection_channel_configuration_: an engine protection channel's configuration record (36 bytes; e2m 10B7 coolant level and 112B-1132 for the other 8 channels, each the same 18 records EP??CG .. EP??RPSS at +0x0 .. +0x22, all 2 bytes unsigned). The same name, field names and offsets as CM848's type (one channel there, e2m 112E); CM550's fields are all word because its code compares them unsigned (bcs / bcc / bls) where CM848 loads some with lha. engine_protection_channel_configuration_table (0x807032) holds the 9 channels
cm550_engine_protection_channel_state_t: an engine protection channel's state record (46 bytes; e2m 10B0 coolant level and 114F-1156, each the same 17 records EP??SA .. EP??RPSA at +0x0 .. +0x2a). CM550's own type: CM848's engine_protection_channel_state_t has the same fields and offsets up to +0x2e but is 62 bytes (it adds copies of the two current fault log entries at +0x2e / +0x36, which CM550's log helpers do not write). engine_protection_channel_state_table (0x80d0dc) holds the 9 channels
engine_protection_channel_history_t: an engine protection channel's history record (30 bytes; e2m 10B2 coolant level and 1140-1147, each the same 12 records EP??FLIX .. EP??RPIN at +0x0 .. +0x1c, e2m subfile 7 with the shutdown records EPSOAE / EPSOCU / EPSOTF). The same name, field names and offsets as CM848's type; CM550's input_extremity is a word (unsigned compares) where CM848 has short. engine_protection_channel_history_table (0x8057c0) holds the 9 channels
